text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning sex could not have served as a basis for choosing between you. An all-male panel selecting one male candidate over another provides no factual or legal grounds for a sex discrimination claim. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and could damage your professional reputation in municipal planning circles.

The municipality likely prioritized political acumen and stakeholder management—reflected in the selected candidate's public consultation background—over technical credentials. Instead of mentioning gender, send a professional follow-up reiterating your request for constructive feedback on how to make your profile more competitive for future leadership roles.
